iteration.area: Team source behavior gate and review snapshot identity
changes: Team delivery detects source changes from host-observed ChangeSet paths, independently of model-declared Artifact.kind.
Every changed source path must be covered by a required host-registered workspace behavior command; code artifacts without a matching source ChangeSet are rejected.
Reviewer evidence now identifies source-bearing ChangeSets and the delivery gate requires final source evidence for them.
Review source snapshots filter ChangeSets by team_id, task_id, and attempt_id to prevent cross-team evidence mixing.
Expanded host source-path recognition for additional language, infrastructure, project, and build files; added corresponding regression test source.

validation.cargo_or_tests: not run; deferred for the single final verification pass

remaining: Converge duplicate ContractSubagentRunner and ProfileSubagentRunner execution assembly without changing their different tool permissions, budgets, and session-recovery behavior.
Finish source and compatibility review of task/attempt repair lifecycle and shared Single/Team completion semantics.
Run one final policy-compliant Rust verification pass after implementation stabilizes; do not claim Team superiority without matched live evidence.
